screening_decisions.reason: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled crossover trial of systemic inosiplex in alopecia totalis. Meets RCT criteria.
Randomized placebo-controlled trial of oral pulse prednisolone in extensive AA. Clearly an RCT evaluating a systemic intervention.
Parallel-group randomized investigator-blinded trial comparing two topical corticosteroids in AA. Meets all inclusion criteria.
Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial of topical minoxidil in extensive AA, including totalis/universalis. RCT.
Double-blind trial with patients assigned to minoxidil or placebo, with a randomized run-in design. Evaluates topical minoxidil in extensive AA. RCT.
Randomized double-blind within-patient comparison of DPCP plus minoxidil versus vehicle in chronic severe AA. RCT.
Patients randomly assigned to three different treatments (topical cyclosporine, PUVA, thymopentin) for AT/AU nonresponders. RCT evaluating multiple interventions.
Small uncontrolled/before-after study in 6 patients; no random allocation to interventions, no comparison group. Not an RCT.
Randomized trial of topical cyclosporin A liposomal formulation versus vehicle in AA. RCT.
Double-blind placebo-controlled trial. Randomization is implicit in such a design; evaluates systemic imipramine for AA. Included as RCT.
Randomized three-arm trial comparing topical immunotherapy, systemic interferon, and combination for severe AA. RCT.
Double-blind study (randomisation implicit) of topical cyclosporin A versus placebo in AA. Likely RCT; conservative inclusion.
Explicitly stated randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of clobetasol foam in AA. RCT.
Randomized, controlled trial of prednisone taper followed by topical minoxidil or vehicle in AA. RCT evaluating systemic and topical interventions.
This is a narrative review/discussion of minoxidil studies, not a primary RCT report. Does not present original trial data.
Described as a controlled trial but randomisation not mentioned. Cannot confirm it is an RCT. Excluded.
Cross-sectional survey of illness perceptions; no intervention, no randomisation. Not an RCT.
Methodological essay about when RCTs are unnecessary; not a clinical trial. Not relevant.
Explicitly a randomized, double-blind, controlled trial of aromatherapy (topical essential oils) in AA. Meets RCT criteria.
Narrative review/summary article; not an original trial. No study design meeting RCT definition.
Retrospective population-based descriptive incidence study; no intervention, not an RCT.
Prognostic factor analysis within a treatment cohort; not a randomized trial. No random allocation.
Subjects were 'divided into three groups matched for age and sex' – no mention of randomisation. Quasi-experimental, not RCT.
Review article on genetics; not an intervention trial. Not an RCT.
Methodology paper about quality assessment in clinical trials; not an interventional study. Not relevant.
